title: San Francisco and the flight to Honolulu through a storm
summary: After sightseeing in San Francisco they fly in a bucket-seat plane through a storm to Honolulu, with the brothers disagreeing over whether General Marshall bumped their plane.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: We got to San Francisco, they were very nice to us. They took us sightseeing, took us to see the bridge, took us up on Nob Hill. And a few historical spots. Then they took us out to Hamilton Field and told us not to leave because we were on alert, see. In about a day and a half, we got ready to fly to Honolulu. The sun was shining bright, beautiful day. We had a bucket job.
We had a plush job.
Huh?
We had a plush job.
No, we had a bucket job, Charles. We had to lay on the floor when the plane --
In Honolulu?
Yeah, going to Honolulu, yeah.
Going to Honolulu we had a plush job because the Marshall bumped us.

No, wait, Charlie, wait, Charlie. When (unintelligible) lay on the floor? We were laying on the floor, and this was a bucket job. And the captain and his navigator was up in front. And we ran into a storm. Ran into a storm going to Honolulu. And the plane did a -- you know how planes will do, and it must have dropped I guess about 50 feet. And it just moved out from under me, see. And I got up, and walked up to the front there, and so the captain had taken over from the lieutenant, see, and he was bucking in there, man, and he was just holding it. He says, 'Don't worry about things. We've run into a storm, man, but everything's going to be all right.'

And you couldn't see a thing in front of you, see. You couldn't see a thing in front of you. And we made it into Honolulu. When we got there, everything was just as clear. It looked like a Christmas tree before we landed, see. But we was bumped in Guam. We used the plush after we got to Honolulu, and the plush took us to Guam and then they took over at Guam. Think real good, (Unintelligible), Charlie, because --
You know why I'm thinking pretty good?
Huh?
You know why I'm thinking pretty good?
Yeah.
HEMLOCK
Because we got into Honolulu and we had a layover there to wait for this bucket job because General Marshall came through there and took that plush job from us in Honolulu.

Wait, (Unintelligible), Charlie. They were waiting for General Marshall when we got there, because all the troops were out there waiting for him. See. General Marshall flew right in, he was about a half an hour behind us, because all the troops were out there, dressed up.
Where, in Honolulu?
In Honolulu, waiting for General Marshall, because he was on his way to China --
Okay, he was on his way. So he took our plane. That's why they were waiting for him in Honolulu, because he took our plane.
But, Charles, we was on the bucket job, Charles. I know this to be a fact.
Okay.
Because I was laying on the floor, me and Rags
I knew we ran into a storm between Guam and Manila. We had the bucket job when we ran into the storm then.
